html: The 2027 show is on Saturday 26 and Sunday 27 June, and the 2027 times and ticket prices are out. The parking details below are from the official site, checked in November 2026, and the train and bus times are from the winter timetables. I would suggest checking the travel times again once the summer timetables are released. Everyone leaves by the same country roads when the show ends. Cars may be held in the car parks during the flying and released in a controlled way afterwards, so I would expect queues onto Shenley Road and the A274. My tip is either to leave before the flying display ends or, if you’re able to, spend more time looking round the static aircraft and the traders and grab some food while the rush leaves.
